subject: Publication objects for your MCP
body:
Newsletter publication data is one object shape the enrichment library does not return: publication identity, audience, topics, the sponsors running in it, momentum, and the article behind each fact, with AI doing the extraction from the issue text.

It arrives as an object rather than a corpus, so an agent or a grid can query by domain or by publication, over REST ([DOCS_LINK]) or through the MCP endpoint you already call ([MCP_LINK]).

For a team this size, licensing that beats building an ingest pipeline for email-first publishers, which is why it exists as a feed rather than a crawl.

I can send a sample of the fields for one segment before anything is wired.
